ml.gate: AUC lift >= .015 and lower Brier than one-parameter calibrated baseline; largest validation AUC wins among gate passers

dataset.sampling: Uniform eligible arrival event, then uniform real resident; sampling with replacement; no IDs used as predictors
dataset.target: Y96: resident actual exit precedes incoming actual exit within 96 hours
dataset.queue_definition: Current live same-vessel residents excluding historically missed LOAD IDs; divide by full next loading-window hours, minimum denominator 1
dataset.rotation_definition: Equality of public vessel and next rotation end; both must have an assigned rotation
dataset.port_weight_diff: Resident minus incoming normalized port/weight loading-order fraction, same vessel only
dataset.raw_etd_minus_s3: Raw ETD minus fraction-adjusted expected S3 loading timestamp

recommendation: Keep the saved Phase 5B checkpoint as final. No Phase 7A candidate clears the complete promotion bar.
track4: A tightly bounded Track 4 single-block common-random-number rollout is warranted as a separate exploration: train-only, action-dependent future relocation dynamics remain untested by these three tracks. Do not replace Phase 5B on this evidence.
